label: accounting v2 study: frozen id beside its v2 id, generic methods on a registered-style 20-bit prime-order curve
description: Every frozen generic method of the accounting v2 change beside its v2 id on the same workloads and the same per-(workload, round) algorithm seed (spec.rs derives one seed per workload and round, shared by every arm). Same curve constructor as docs/ecbench/specs/smoke-prime-v2.json (prime_search, 20 bits, seed 59297), eight single-target workloads. rho.plain has no v2 id and is the unchanged-id control; rho-neg-v2-aa repeats the reference as the A/A arm. Counts are the result; wall time is descriptive only.
